name: Network Egress Policy
description: Define and enforce which processes can make network requests, to which hosts, on which ports, and using which protocols. Network requests not matching policy are blocked with receipts.
purpose: Prevent unauthorized network egress by enforcing a process-level network policy that restricts which hosts, ports, and protocols each process is permitted to contact.
acceptanceCriteria: Network egress policy is defined per process or process group
Allowed hosts, ports, and protocols are enumerated in policy
Network requests not matching policy are blocked
Blocked requests produce security event receipts
Policy is enforceable at the OS/network level (e.g., firewall, netfilter)
Inspected egress requests produce audit log entries
